### 2026-10-06 – I just finished up designing my PCB and exported the files. It took me way longer than it should have to figure out how to add an image on to the PCB, but I eventually figured it out. After that, I ex

**1h**

I just finished up designing my PCB and exported the files. It took me way longer than it should have to figure out how to add an image on to the PCB, but I eventually figured it out. After that, I exported all of the design and manufacturing files and put them in my project's GitHub. Now I just need to work on the firmware. I am currently considering redesigning the project to have more buttons.

### 2026-10-08 – In this session I completely redesigned my PCB. I created it more like a macro pad with six buttons instead of the 2 that were in the first one I designed. This was a bit easier than the first time be

**5h**

In this session I completely redesigned my PCB. I created it more like a macro pad with six buttons instead of the 2 that were in the first one I designed. This was a bit easier than the first time because I already had a decent idea of what I was doing, but I still had a few hiccups that ended up taking a while to resolve. Now I need to shift my focus from hardware to software and creating the Bill of materials.
